name: Blank Scroll
description: Crafting Material. Obtained by Loot Collecting scrolls from Recipe Dungeons.

name: Bleached Bone
description: Crafting Material. These bones are commonly found littering the ground in Dragonfire Peaks.

name: Bottle
description: Crafting Material. Bottles are found growing wildly throughout the world or can be grown through Gardening.

name: Sticky Ichor
description: Crafting Material. Found by defeating bugs.

name: Sunlight Bulb
description: Crafting Material. Found in the Giant Sunflowers that pepper the Peaceful Hills.

name: Chestnut
description: Crafting Material. Harvested from Chestnut Seeds, which are craftable at the Gardening Bench.

name: Wild Cupcake
description: Crafting Material. Found growing from the ground in Candoria, or grown through Gardening.

name: Somber Soul
description: Crafting Material. Found in ore veins in the Cursed Vale biome.

name: Diamond
description: Crafting Material. Created at the Ringcrafting Bench.

name: Shadow Diamond
description: Crafting Material. Created at the Ringcrafting Bench.

name: Purifying Dragon Flame
description: Crafting Material used to forge Radiant equipment. Craftable at the Dragon Crucible.

name: Enchanted Wood
description: Crafting Material. Usually found growing in the Fae Forest, Medieval Highlands, or Cursed Vale biomes, but also obtainable through Gardening.

name: Eye of Q'bthulhu
description: Forging Material. Found rarely as a drop from invaders and by Loot Collecting rare equipment.

name: Faerie Dust
description: Crafting Material. Drops from Fae enemies, most commonly found in the Fae Wilds.

name: Plasmic Solution
description: Crafting Material. Harvested from Plasma Condensers, which are craftable at the Gardening Bench.

name: Rich Fertilizer
description: Crafting Material. Harvested from Unripe Fertilizer Heaps, which are craftable at the Gardening Bench.

name: Flux
description: Crafting Material. Gain Flux from using the Loot Collector on equipment or selling items on the marketplace.

name: Twice-Forged Shadow Soul
description: Rare Crafting Material. Obtained from Loot Collecting Shadow Level 2 equipment.

name: Thrice-Forged Shadow Soul
description: Rare Crafting Material. Obtained from Loot Collecting Shadow Level 3 equipment. Can also be crafted at the Shadowy Market with Twice-Forged Shadow Souls.

name: Quad-Forged Shadow Soul
description: Rare Crafting Material. Obtained from Loot Collecting Shadow Level 4 equipment. Can also be crafted at the Shadowy Market with Thrice-Forged Shadow Souls.

name: Penta-Forged Shadow Soul
description: Rare Crafting Material. Obtained from Loot Collecting Shadow Level 5 equipment. Can also be crafted at the Shadowy Market with Quad-Forged Shadow Souls.

name: Golden Soul
description: Crafting Material. Found rarely within ore nodes in most biomes.

name: Steed Feed
description: Crafting Material that is used to craft mounts. Harvested from Steed Feed Seed, which can be crafted at the Gardening Bench.

name: Rich Mulch
description: A rich medium for growing plants. Used to craft plant seeds.

name: Mushroom Chunk
description: Crafting Material. Gained through Gardening and from mushrooms found in the world.

name: Shapestone Ore
description: Crafting Material. A common, purple ore found in most biomes.

name: Primordial Flame
description: Crafting Material. An uncommon ore found within Shapestone, Formicite, and Infinium veins.

name: Glacial Shard
description: Crafting Material. An uncommon ore found only within Permafrost zones.

name: Infinium Ore
description: Crafting Material. A rare, golden ore found in most biomes.

name: Crystallized Cloud
description: Crafting Material. A unique ore found only in the Sky Realms.

name: Formicite Ore
description: Crafting Material. An uncommon, turquoise ore found in most biomes.

name: Pearl of Wisdom
description: Forging Material. Used to add new stats and stat boosts to equipment. Found rarely when defeating enemies and Loot Collecting equipment.

name: Perfect Prism
description: Open it to obtain 1000 flux.

name: Pumpkin
description: Crafting Material. Harvested from Pumpkin Seeds, which can be crafted at the Gardening Bench.

name: Radiant Shard
description: Crafting Material. Earned by completing the Dark Heart dungeons found in the Sky Realms.

name: Robotic Salvage
description: Crafting Material. Found by defeating robotic enemies in Neon City and Neon City, Luminopolis.

name: Ancient Scale
description: Crafting Material. Obtained by Loot Collecting rare fish.

name: Enchanted Scale
description: Crafting Material. Obtained by Loot Collecting Enchanted fish.

name: Golden Seashell
description: Crafting Material. Found most often in the Treasure Isles.

name: Candy Corn
description: Crafting Material. Used to craft items at the Shadowy Station in Crafter's Corner of the Trove Hub. Found by defeating Pumpkin dungeons in any biome or world. Candy Corn will vanish shortly after Shadow's Eve 2019.

name: Shadow Shard
description: Crafting Material. Used to craft mounts and items on the Shadowy Market such as Shadow Caches. Can be found in Delves.

name: Heart of Darkness
description: Rare Crafting Material. Found in Shadow Caches, which can be bought for Shadow Shards in the Shadowy Market.

name: Spring Bloom
description: Crafting Material. Harvested from Spring Bloom Seeds which can be crafted at the Gardening Bench.

name: Tentacle of Q'bthulhu
description: Forging Material. Found by defeating invaders and by Loot Collecting rare equipment.

name: Glim
description: Trading Material. Exchange for items from the pirates of Treasure Isles. Obtained by Loot Collecting fish and breaking plants in the world.

name: Water Drop
description: A drop of crystalline water. Used to craft seeds.

name: Arena Coin
description: Spend with the Battle Broker to unlock arena rewards. The Battle Broker can be found in the Battle Station in the Trove Hub. Earned by competing in non-Bomber Royale PVP.

name: Megaflux Tank
description: Crafted material used to efficiently store large quantities of Flux. Craftable at the Adventurer's Crafting Bench or rarely found in Titan's Treasure Chests.

name: Forged Radiant Soul
description: Rare crafting material. Obtained from Loot Collecting Radiant equipment. Can also be crafted at the Shadowy Market with Penta-Forged Shadow Souls.

name: Meteorite Chunk
description: Crafting Material. An extratrovestrial mineral found in Jurassic Jungle zones.

name: Meteorite Fragment
description: Crafting Material. Found only in the Primal Preserve tree canopy of the Jurassic Jungle.

name: Griffon Talisman
description: Crafting Material. Use at the Mount Crafting Bench to craft a griffon mount. Found very rarely in Cursed Skylands worlds.

name: Meownt Talisman
description: Crafting Material. Use at the Mount Crafting Bench to craft a meownt mount. Found very rarely in Moonless Dark (10) and lower adventure worlds.

name: Centaur Talisman
description: Crafting Material. Use at the Mount Crafting Bench to craft a centaur mount. Found very rarely in Uber Twilight (12) and higher adventure worlds.

name: Corgi Talisman
description: Crafting Material. Use at the Mount Crafting Bench to craft a corgi mount. Found very rarely in Moonless Dark (10) and lower adventure worlds.

name: Llama Talisman
description: Crafting Material. Use at the Mount Crafting Bench to craft a llama mount. Found very rarely in all adventure worlds.

name: Shmeep Talisman
description: Crafting Material. Use at the Mount Crafting Bench to craft a shmeep mount. Found very rarely in Pure Midnight (11) and higher adventure worlds.

name: Rat Talisman
description: Crafting Material. Use at the Mount Crafting Bench to craft a rat mount. Found very rarely in Pure Midnight (11) and higher adventure worlds.

name: Celestial Diamond
description: Crafting material. Created at the Ringcrafting bench.

name: Forged Stellar Soul
description: Rare crafting material. Obtained from Loot Collecting Stellar equipment. Can also be crafted at the Shadowy Market with Forged Radiant Souls.

name: Cinnabar
description: Crafting material. A mysterious reddish ore native to the Forbidden Spires.

name: Panda Talisman
description: Crafting Material. Use at the Mount Crafting Bench to craft a panda mount. Found very rarely in Pure Midnight (11) and higher adventure worlds.

name: PembloCoin
description: A form of cryptocurrency favoured by lovers of canines. Found very rarely in Neon City, Luminopolis ore veins.

name: SkygoldCoin
description: A form of cryptocurrency favoured by sky-high rollers. Found very rarely in Neon City, Luminopolis ore veins.

name: NotTroveCoin
description: A form of cryptocurrency favoured by anarchists and those who rage against the established order. Found very rarely in Neon City, Luminopolis ore veins.

name: CurrentCoin
description: A form of cryptocurrency favoured by those who like to clean-sweep the exchanges. Found very rarely in Neon City, Luminopolis ore veins.

name: Charged Circuit
description: Uncommon Crafting Material. Used to craft things at the Resistor Workbench in Neon City, Luminopolis. Can be crafted at the Resistor Workbench or found in Lesser Neon Caches.

name: Logic Loop
description: Uncommon Crafting Material. Used to craft things at the Resistor Workbench in Neon City, Luminopolis. Can be crafted at the Resistor Workbench or found in Lesser Neon Caches.

name: Memory Matrix
description: Uncommon Crafting Material. Used to craft things at the Resistor Workbench in Neon City, Luminopolis. Can be crafted at the Resistor Workbench or found in Lesser Neon Caches.

name: Plain Metal Ring
description: Simple band of Formicite. Crafted at the Ringcrafting Bench.

name: Plasmium
description: Crafting Material. Used to craft things at the Resistor Workbench in Neon City, Luminopolis. Found by defeating robotic enemies in Neon City and Neon City, Luminopolis.

name: Acrobat Bark
description: Geode Cave Crafting Material. Hangs down from the ceilings in Tiers 2-4 of Moonglow Grotto.

name: Ancient Gears
description: Geode Cave Crafting Material. Scavenged from the deepest corners of Tier 5 of the Geode caves.

name: Blazine
description: Geode Cave Crafting Material. Heat emanates from this ore found only in Tiers 1-3 of Sunken Sunvault.

name: Bond Crystalizer
description: A manifestation of the experiences you and your companion have shared. Used to level up companions. Craftable on the Crystallogy Workbench.

name: Builderite
description: Geode Cave Crafting Material. One of the Builder's favorite ores, found deep throughout Tiers 3-5 of the Geode caves.

name: Builder's Blossom
description: Geode Cave Crafting Material. Blooms deep within Tiers 4-5 of Verdant Veins.

name: Cave Birds
description: Geode Cave Crafting Material. Flowers in Tiers 2-4 of Sunken Sunvault.

name: Cave Kelp
description: Geode Cave Crafting Material. Grows wild in Tiers 1-3 of Verdant Veins.

name: Chronozine
description: Geode Cave Crafting Material. The Ancients favored this ore that grows deep within Tiers 3-5 of Verdant Veins.

name: Cogwine
description: Geode Cave Crafting Material. Extracted from rare blooms in Tiers 2-4 of Verdant Veins.

name: Day Drop
description: Geode Cave Crafting Material. Grows throughout Tiers 1-3 of the Geode caves.

name: Dream Dew
description: Geode Cave Crafting Material. Nectar pulled from flowers in Tiers 1-3 of Moonglow Grotto.

name: Everlight
description: Geode Cave Crafting Material. Travelers must delve far into Tier 5 of Sunken Sunvault to mine these fiery sunstones.

name: Fireheart Flower
description: Geode Cave Crafting Material. Bold blooms rarely found in Tiers 4-5 of Sunken Sunvault.

name: Geminite
description: Geode Cave Crafting Material. Two bold colors adorn the sides of this ore found in Tiers 1-3 of Verdant Veins.

name: Gleamstone
description: Geode Cave Crafting Material. An all-purpose ore, scattered throughout Tiers 1-3 of the Geode caves.

name: Lunarium
description: Geode Cave Crafting Material. Crescents adorn this ore found in the deepest parts of Tier 5 of Moonglow Grotto.

name: Mightstone
description: Geode Cave Crafting Material. This fabled ore can only be found in the deepest parts of Tier 5 of Verdant Veins.

name: Moonlit Moss
description: Geode Cave Crafting Material. Clinging plants found throughout Tiers 2-4 of the Geode caves.

name: Moonstone
description: Geode Cave Crafting Material. Delicate, shimmery ore harvested only in Tiers 1-3 of Moonglow Grotto.

name: Queen Trumpets
description: Geode Cave Crafting Material. Majestic plants rarely found in Tiers 4-5 of Moonglow Grotto.

name: Quirkstone
description: Geode Cave Crafting Material. Confetti-covered ore found deep in Tiers 3-5 of Moonglow Grotto.

name: Sparkzite
description: Geode Cave Crafting Material. Sparks sometimes fly from this ore that grows deep in Tiers 3-5 of Sunken Sunvault.

name: Sun Sap
description: Geode Cave Crafting Material. Liquid extracted from flowering pods in Tiers 1-3 of Sunken Sunvault.

name: Wallflowers
description: Geode Cave Crafting Material. Shy climbing plants that grow throughout Tiers 4-5 of the Geode caves.

name: Forge Fragment
description: A small piece of the forge used by the Shaper. Obtained by Loot Collecting Crystaline Gear.

name: Nitro-Glitterine
description: Crafting Material. A sparkling, highly volatile ore. This ore is found uncommonly on the Geode Topside.

name: Veridium
description: Crafting Material. A crystalline green and blue ore that hardens reality against extra-dimensional invasions. This ore is found commonly on the Geode Topside.

name: Moonlight Temper
description: Allows more power from Moonlight Bulbs to be extracted by plants. Can be found inside Quality Compost Heap and Superior Compost Heap, craftable at a Harvesting Station.

name: Qubbage
description: Crafting Material. Harvested from Qubbage Seeds, which are craftable at the Gardening Bench.

name: Bunfeed
description: Crafting Material. Harvested from Bunfeed Seeds, which are craftable at the Gardening Bench.

name: Corn on the Cube
description: Crafting Material. Harvested from Corn on the Cube Seeds, which are craftable at the Gardening Bench.

name: Uggplant
description: Crafting Material. Harvested from Uggplant Seeds, which are craftable at the Gardening Bench.

name: Purp'lil
description: Crafting Material. Harvested from Purp'lil Seeds, which are craftable at the Gardening Bench.

name: Onionito
description: Crafting Material. Harvested from Onionito Seeds, which are craftable at the Gardening Bench.

name: Totter Tate
description: Crafting Material. Harvested from Totter Tate Seeds, which are craftable at the Gardening Bench.

name: Unicorn Chard
description: Crafting Material. Harvested from Unicorn Chard Seeds, which are craftable at the Gardening Bench.

name: Qumato
description: Crafting Material. Harvested from Qumato Seeds, which are craftable at the Gardening Bench.

name: Cinnamellon
description: Crafting Material. Harvested from Cinnamellon Seeds, which are craftable at the Gardening Bench.

name: Carpet Talisman
description: Found very rarely in The Understacks in Delves of Depth 120 and deeper.

name: Neonium Coin
description: Earned only when playing from valid locations

name: Bardium
description: Crafting Material. A pulsing gold and blue ore that when touched fills ones head with musical inspiration. This ore is found rarely in Tier 5 of the Geode caves.

name: Paragon's Mark
description: Very rarely obtained from Primal Paragon Pinatas. Used to craft items at the PARAGON WORKBENCH, in the PARAGON'S PALACE beneath the CLUB HOUSE in the Hub.

name: Irradiant Soul
description: Crafting Material. Obtained by composting the trophy of an Irradiant creature from the Sundered Uplands.

name: Irradium Ore
description: Crafting Material. A common, energy-laden ore found in the Cloud Layer of the Sundered Uplands.

name: Unnatural Device
description: Crafting Material. Its eerie, irregular clicks and hums give no clue to its purpose or origin. Found rarely in the Ashen Wastes layer of the Sundered Uplands.

name: Emberslag Ore
description: Crafting Material. A common, dense ore found in the Ashen Wastes layer of the Sundered Uplands.

name: Ashfern Sporeling
description: Crafting Material. Depending on the magnification factor of your eyes, these lil' friendlies can be surprisingly cute! Found in the Ashen Wastes layer of the Sundered Uplands, and valued by the Fungi Scrollpeddlers and Thingshapers that frequent the region.

name: Ashen Soul
description: Crafting Material. Obtained by composting the trophy of an Ashen creature from the Sundered Uplands.

name: Irradiant Powercell
description: Crafting Material. Bristling with energy, this powerful resource can be used at the Sundered Uplands Workbench. Found in the Cloud Layer of the Sundered Uplands.

name: Basic Canned Fish
description: Canned common fish. Used to cook food at the Angler's Grill.

name: Premium Canned Fish
description: Canned rare fish. Used to cook food at the Angler's Grill.

name: Scale of the Depths
description: Crafting Material. Obtained by Loot Collecting rare fish from the Depths.

name: Turtle Shell
description: Crafting Material. Obtained by Loot Collecting Turtles caught with the Turtle Trawler.

name: Select Canned Fish
description: Canned uncommon fish. Used to cook food at the Angler's Grill.

name: Deepstone
description: Found rarely in Long Shade difficulty (15) worlds. Used to craft items and upgrading Mystic Gears.

name: Depths Core
description: Found commonly in Long Shade difficulty (15) worlds, when opening fivestar dungeon vaults with basic keys or sparkling keys.

name: Kraken Shell Fragment
description: Found commonly in Long Shade difficulty (15) worlds, after killing a specified mob which spawns after looting the chests.

name: Soul of the Depths
description: Found commonly in Long Shade difficulty (15) worlds, when opening fivestar dungeon vaults with basic keys or sparkling keys on Monday. Besides this, Soul of the Depths can be found in the Depths.

name: Lichenstone
description: Found in Long Shade difficulty (15) worlds.

name: Endurance Rune
description: Breaks sometimes when you take damage. Taking Damage can also trigger an Endurance effect, reducing damage taken, increasing Maximum Health, and granting Stability. Runes create Rune Fragments when they break. Rune Fragments are used for the Runecrafting Profession and Progression tree.

name: Restoration Rune
description: Breaks after defeating an enemy, restoring a charge of your equipped flask. Runes create Rune Fragments when they break. Rune Fragments are used for the Runecrafting Profession and Progression tree.

name: Replenishment Rune
description: Breaks when you're hit by an attack that would kill you, reducing your cooldowns by 33%. Runes create Rune Fragments when they break. Rune Fragments are used for the Runecrafting Profession and Progression tree.

name: Rally Rune
description: Breaks when an enemy is defeated, healing you for 50% of your health. Runes create Rune Fragments when they break. Rune Fragments are used for the Runecrafting Profession and Progression tree.

name: Abyssal Rune
description: Breaks when you would take damage from lava or Jellous's flames but grants immunity to the damage from lava and Jellous's flames. Runes create Rune Fragments when they break. Rune Fragments are used for the Runecrafting Profession and Progression tree.

name: Swift Rune
description: Breaks when you dash, increasing attack speed by 30% and movement speed by 10 for 60 seconds. Runes create Rune Fragments when they break. Rune Fragments are used for the Runecrafting Profession and Progression tree.

name: Abundance Rune
description: Breaks upon completing a dungeon, spawning a bonus chest. Runes create Rune Fragments when they break. Rune Fragments are used for the Runecrafting Profession and Progression tree.

name: Zephyr Rune
description: Breaks when you take damage from acid, making you immune for 10 seconds. Runes create Rune Fragments when they break. Rune Fragments are used for the Runecrafting Profession and Progression tree.

name: Repel Rune
description: Breaks when you're hit by an attack that would kill you, triggering an explosion that knock backs enemies and roots them. Runes create Rune Fragments when they break. Rune Fragments are used for the Runecrafting Profession and Progression tree.

name: Harvest Rune
description: Breaks upon completing a dungeon, granting a buff that gives a chance to obtain Encrusted Runic Trunk when harvesting resources unique to Long Shade difficulty (15). Runes create Rune Fragments when they break. Rune Fragments are used for the Runecrafting Profession and Progression tree.

name: Recursion Rune
description: Breaks when you land a critical attack, granting 35% Critical Damage for 60 seconds. Runes create Rune Fragments when they break. Rune Fragments are used for the Runecrafting Profession and Progression tree.

name: Condemn Rune
description: Breaks when you're hit by an attack that would kill you, triggering a rage that increases your damage by 20%. Runes create Rune Fragments when they break. Rune Fragments are used for the Runecrafting Profession and Progression tree.

name: Fury Rune
description: Breaks sometimes when you deal damage. In addition hitting can trigger one of three Fury Rune buffs, increasing Critical Hit Chance, Critical Hit Damage, and overall Damage. Runes create Rune Fragments when they break. Rune Fragments are used for the Runecrafting Profession and Progression tree.

name: Pyric Rune
description: Breaks when you use your ultimate ability, creating a large fire around you burning your enemies for 10 seconds. Runes create Rune Fragments when they break. Rune Fragments are used for the Runecrafting Profession and Progression tree.

name: Focus Rune
description: Breaks when you spend all of your energy, replenishing your energy to full. Runes create Rune Fragments when they break. Rune Fragments are used for the Runecrafting Profession and Progression tree.

name: Empty Rune
description: Breaks when you complete a Dungeon, granting some Rune Fragments. Runes create Rune Fragments when they break. Rune Fragments are used for the Runecrafting Profession and Progression tree.

name: Shining Rune
description: Breaks when your magic find triggers, granting a Gearcrafter's Vault.

name: Ore Rune
description: Breaks as a result of mining resources, granting a bonus chance at a Miner's Trove when mining resources. Runes create Rune Fragments when they break. Rune Fragments are used for the Runecrafting Profession and Progression tree.

name: Rippling Rune
description: Breaks when catching a fish from a pool, granting a buff that can award Marks of the Angler when completing dungeons.

name: Blank Rune
description: Breaks when you complete a Dungeon, granting a few Rune Fragments. Runes create Rune Fragments when they break. Rune Fragments are used for the Runecrafting Profession and Progression tree.

name: Metallic Rune
description: Breaks on damage taken, granting a protecting shield that reduces damage by 20% for 10 seconds and increases Stability. Runes create Rune Fragments when they break. Rune Fragments are used for the Runecrafting Profession and Progression tree.

name: Depths Rune
description: Breaks when you complete a Dungeon, granting many Rune Fragments. Runes create Rune Fragments when they break. Rune Fragments are used for the Runecrafting Profession and Progression tree.

name: Runic Ore
description: Found occasionally in Long Shade difficulty (15) worlds. Mainly used for crafting items.

name: Abyssal Coral
description: Found in the Hollowed Dunes biome in Long Shade difficulty (15) worlds. Used to craft items, spawn bosses from the obelisks.

name: Zephyr Coral
description: Found in the Weather Wastelands biome in Long Shade difficulty (15) worlds. Used to craft items, spawn bosses from the obelisks.

name: Chocolate Algae
description: Produces 10 Chocolate Algae when fully charged. Standard Leaflets can be charged without cooldown, but are consumed when fully charged. Charges in Dungeons, Geode Caves, and Delves.

name: Pyric Core
description: Found in the Dragonfire Peaks biome in Long Shade difficulty (15) worlds. Used to craft items and spawn bosses from the obelisks.

name: Cursed Coral
description: Produces 10 Cursed Coral when fully charged. Standard Leaflets can be charged without cooldown, but are consumed when fully charged. Charges in Dungeons, Geode Caves, and Delves.

name: Depths Coolant
description: Produces 10 Depths Coolant when fully charged. Standard Leaflets can be charged without cooldown, but are consumed when fully charged. Charges in Dungeons, Geode Caves, and Delves.

name: Pyric Coral
description: Found in the Cerise Sandsea biome in Long Shade difficulty (15) worlds. Used to craft items, spawn bosses from the obelisks.

name: Lichenstone
description: Produces 10 Lichenstone when fully charged. Standard Leaflets can be charged without cooldown, but are consumed when fully charged. Charges in Dungeons, Geode Caves, and Delves.

name: Pyrite Seashell
description: Produces 10 Pyrite Seashell when fully charged. Standard Leaflets can be charged without cooldown, but are consumed when fully charged. Charges in Dungeons, Geode Caves, and Delves.

name: Surface Dried Seaweed
description: Produces 10 Surface Dried Seaweed when fully charged. Standard Leaflets can be charged without cooldown, but are consumed when fully charged. Charges in Dungeons, Geode Caves, and Delves.

name: Cinnabark
description: Produces 10 Cinnabark when fully charged. Standard Leaflets can be charged without cooldown, but are consumed when fully charged. Charges in Dungeons, Geode Caves, and Delves.

name: Depths Mana
description: Produces 10 Depths Mana when fully charged. Standard Leaflets can be charged without cooldown, but are consumed when fully charged. Charges in Dungeons, Geode Caves, and Delves.

name: Depths Mold
description: Produces 10 Depths Mold when fully charged. Standard Leaflets can be charged without cooldown, but are consumed when fully charged. Charges in Dungeons, Geode Caves, and Delves.

name: Irradiated Rune Fragment
description: Found in the Sundered Uplands biome in Long Shade difficulty (15) worlds. Can be used to spawn obelisk boss and crafting items.

name: Chunk of Runic Ore
description: Found occasionally in Long Shade difficulty (15) worlds.
